docs.title: PixelArtPitch
docs.summary: Short pixel-art pitch videos, made by a crew of AI agents while you watch, steer and pick.

docs.title: Glossary
docs.summary: One line per term. Where a term has a source file, it is named in brackets.

docs.summary: The look of every PAP video. Each rule is a number or a yes/no, so you can check it on a still. Terms: GLOSSARY.md. Recipes and their params: RECIPES.md and packages/engine/src/re…

docs.title: Reviewer
docs.summary: Purpose: Judge the video like a strict viewer and report blockers and polish, each with a timestamp. You are independent: you see the renders and the brief only, never the code or…

docs.title: Writer
docs.summary: Purpose: Turn the brief into a script of cues. Offer 3 distinct angles at G1, then refine the chosen one. Read first: WRITING-GUIDE.md.

docs.title: PAP Writer

tools.name: ask_pip
tools.title: Ask Pip
tools.description: A crew member's question goes to Pip, who answers from the brief and the person's decisions, or asks the person when only they know (names, claims, rights, taste, budget). Give 2-6 options and a recommended one.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.title: Ask the user
tools.description: Ask the user one multiple-choice question only they can answer (names, order, claims, rights, budget or deadline). Give 2-6 options and a recommended one. Waits for the answer. For people and MCP clients; crew members ask Pip with ask_pip.

tools.name: audio_render
tools.title: Render and measure the sound
tools.description: Render SFX, music and the mix (with the narration if any) and report loudness against the target.

tools.name: cast_asset
tools.title: Use a library asset in this project
tools.description: Add a public library asset to the project under a name scenes use. Optional frameAlias maps names the project uses to the asset's frame names.

tools.name: crew_pause
tools.title: Pause the crew
tools.description: Pause after the current step (default) or now.

tools.name: crew_request_change
tools.title: Ask the crew for a change
tools.description: Turn a person's change request into a note for the role that owns it: new characters, beats or scenes (category story) to the Director, who re-plans just those scenes; how a scene looks or moves (art, scene, timing) to the Animator; script words (text) to the Writer; sound to the Sound Designer. If the crew is idle it reopens that stage and runs from there, keeping finished work outside the change; if the crew is working, the note waits for the next review. Put only the person's request in text; to include open review notes, pass their ids in alsoNotes.

input.text: add a friend who tells the hero about the app
the music is too loud at the end

tools.name: crew_run
tools.title: Start the crew
tools.description: Start (or continue) the crew on a project from its current stage. Returns at once; follow crew_status.

tools.name: crew_status
tools.title: Crew status
tools.description: Stage, gates, tasks, open questions, budget and ETA of a project's crew.

tools.name: export_video
tools.title: Export the video
tools.description: Render the final video for one delivery (with sound and subtitles) into the project's out/ folder.

tools.name: feature_request
tools.title: Log a feature request
tools.description: Write down something a person asked for that the studio can't do yet, with the context it came up in. It only appends one line to a log.

input.context: asked for a phone story version

tools.name: files_list
tools.title: The project's files
tools.description: List the finished files in the project's out/ folder (videos, subtitles, sound, stills) with their size and download URL.

tools.name: gate_decide
tools.title: Pass or reject a gate
tools.description: Approve a gate (brief, script, animatic, rough cut, final) or ask for changes with reasons.

tools.name: library_get
tools.title: Look at a library asset
tools.description: An asset's metadata and its preview sheet image; with grid=true also its letter-grid frames.

tools.name: library_search
tools.title: Search the asset library
tools.description: Find reusable public assets by words, kind or size. Reuse beats drawing: check here before asking for new art.

tools.name: note_add
tools.title: Leave a note
tools.description: Pin a note to a scene, cue, asset or time range; it is routed to the role that owns it.

tools.name: note_list
tools.title: Notes
tools.description: Notes from the user and the reviewers, optionally only those for one role.

tools.name: note_resolve
tools.title: Resolve a note
tools.description: Mark a note done (with what changed) or declined (with why).

tools.name: project_create
tools.title: Start a project
tools.description: Create a new project folder from a brief. The crew then writes the script, storyboard, art and sound.

tools.name: project_fork
tools.title: Make another one like this
tools.description: Start a new project from this one: it keeps the settings, cast and style, and gets a new brief. The script, storyboard and renders are not copied. The new project waits at the brief for the person.

input.title: Bakery launch
input.brief: A 20 s launch video for a small bakery's new sourdough.

tools.name: project_get
tools.title: Read the project
tools.description: Read part of the project document. Use section "summary" first; "scene:<id>" reads one scene. Returns the revision you must pass back as baseRev when you change something.

tools.name: project_history
tools.title: Change history
tools.description: List the changes made to the project (author, reason, operations), newest last.

tools.name: project_list
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects this studio knows, with their id, title and folder.

tools.name: project_patch
tools.title: Change the project (JSON Patch)
tools.description: Apply RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations to the project document with a short reason. The result is validated; pass the baseRev you read. Prefer the small typed tools when one fits.

tools.name: project_undo
tools.title: Undo a change
tools.description: Undo one change by its number, by appending its inverse.

tools.name: question_answer
tools.title: Answer a question
tools.description: Answer one of the crew's questions by option id.

tools.name: question_list
tools.title: Open questions
tools.description: Questions the crew asked that wait for an answer.

tools.name: recipe_list
tools.title: The recipe menu
tools.description: Every scene recipe: what it is for, its asset slots, params with defaults and ranges, and its minimum length. Recipes are the building blocks of declarative scenes.

tools.name: render_contact
tools.title: Contact sheet
tools.description: One frame per interval across the whole video in one image: the fastest way to judge pacing.

tools.name: render_still
tools.title: Render a still
tools.description: Render the frame at a scene time (seconds, or a time expression) as a PNG image you can look at.

tools.name: scene_set_layers
tools.title: Set a scene's own layers
tools.description: Replace the hand-placed layers of a declarative scene (drawn above its recipes). Advanced: prefer recipes.

tools.name: scene_set_recipes
tools.title: Fill a scene with recipes
tools.description: Set the recipes a declarative scene is built from (in drawing order), each with its params. Use recipe_list to see the menu and each recipe's params. Errors come back with a fix.

tools.name: script_estimate
tools.title: Estimate read time
tools.description: Words and seconds for lines of script at the project's speaking rate, and whether they fit the target length.

tools.name: script_set_cues
tools.title: Write the script
tools.description: Replace the script with these cues (one idea of at most 12 words each, in order). Ids are kept for unchanged positions so scenes stay anchored.

tools.name: sfx_list
tools.title: Sound effect types
tools.description: The 8-bit sound effects the synth can play, and the keep table used when there is a voice.

tools.name: sfx_set
tools.title: Set the sound plan
tools.description: Extra sound effects on cue-anchored times, and the keep table (null keeps every effect the scenes emit; with a voice use the voice table).

tools.name: storyboard_set
tools.title: Lay out the scenes
tools.description: Replace the list of scenes: ids, titles, cue-anchored windows and the cues each carries. New scenes start as declarative scenes with a night backdrop; existing ones keep their recipes and layers.

tools.name: subtitles_translate
tools.title: Translate the subtitles
tools.description: Translate the subtitle lines into another language and write out/<id>.<lang>.srt and .vtt. Cue ids and timings stay the project's; the pixel font draws basic Latin only, so burnInPossible says whether the picture could show them.

tools.name: time_eval
tools.title: Check a time expression
tools.description: Evaluate a time expression such as "S(c02)+0.4" or "intro.to" to seconds, or get a fix hint.

tools.name: timeline_get
tools.title: Resolved timing
tools.description: Every cue, scene and event time in seconds, as the renderer sees them.

tools.name: vo_align
tools.title: Align the narration
tools.description: Find where each cue is spoken in a narration file (pauses + word counts) and propose cue times. With apply=true the times are written and everything anchored to the cues moves with them.
